description: This file defines the 'MyOpportunitiesDashlet' class, which extends the generic Dashlet class for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform. It creates a customizable dashlet for displaying 'Opportunities' in the user interface, including initialization, data loading, and fixing display column issues.

classes.name: MyOpportunitiesDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class for displaying user-specific opportunities in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dashlet with data, sets the title if not provided, and prepares search fields and columns.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Overrides the parent process method; includes a fix for display column issues related to 'amount'.
